notes:
Account snapshot: Tangram Commerce is a mid-to-large marketplace handling payments and refunds for 200+ vendors. Heavy seasonal peaks (Black Friday windows) drive high concurrency. Primary ask: agent UI integrations that can call backend support APIs (Zendesk, in-house ticketing, Stripe/Adyen refund APIs) safely and idempotently.

Recent timeline (short bullets):
- 2025-09-01: Lead created via conference meetup (Jordan).
- 2025-10-14: Intro call; product fit confirmed for agent assist + refunds automation. (ff_2026-02-18_tangram-intro ref).
- 2026-01-08: Security questionnaire submitted; initial SOC2 + partial PCI posture noted.
- 2026-02-12: Deep-dive demo of Redwood Dedicated; Tangram requests throughput projections and cold-start behavior.
- 2026-02-18: POC kickoff call. Agreed success metrics: error rate <0.1% for tool calls, mean latency for agent assist UI <=200ms p50, 95th under load <=450ms; can sustain 1k QPS burst for 5 minutes without degraded retry storms.
- 2026-03-02: POC check-in — pivoted to private VPC deploy for payment flow testing. (ff_2026-03-02_poc-checkin).

Technical requirements and notes: 
- Tool-calling: need robust, observable connectors to Zendesk (create/update ticket), internal ticketing APIs, and payment providers for refunds. Must support idempotency keys, exponential backoff, at-least-once vs exactly-once decision documented.
- Security: Red-team asked for audit trail for every automated tool call with token-level attribution; KMS integration mandatory for any customer key material.
- Data residency: refund payloads include card last4 and limited PI; prefer keeping transaction-processing in private VPC or on-prem worker pools to reduce PCI scope.
- Failover model: prefer primary Dedicated/Private with hosted Redwood fallback (read-only assist) — must provide deterministic rollback strategy for partial failures.
- Rate limiting & throttling: predictable per-tenant throttles; Tangram wants SLOs and a pre-signed escalation policy when throttles engage during sales spikes.
- Models: plan to run smaller quantized causal models on Dedicated for chat completions and offload heavy evals to Redwood Optimize suggestions. Preference to pin model versions for POC then test automated fallback to hosted gpt-like variants.

POC specifics:
- Scope: agent assist UI integration + tool-calling path for refund create/update + ticket summarization pipeline.
- Success metrics: 95% correct ticket mapping, <0.5% erroneous refund invocation, latency targets above.
- Data set: Tangram provided 3k anonymized ticket threads + 200 labeled refund scenarios for training/eval.
- Timeline: 6-week POC with mid-POC review (week 3) and security sign-off parallel.
